base = fillet(base.edges(), fillet_radius)

rib = Box(rib_width, rib_height, arm_thickness)
for i in range(rib_count):
    x = (i - (rib_count - 1) / 2) * rib_spacing
    base = base + Pos(x, arm_width / 2 + rib_height / 2, 0) * rib

base = base - Cylinder(hole_diameter / 2, arm_thickness * 2)

for x in [-arm_length / 2 + mount_hole_offset, arm_length / 2 - mount_hole_offset]:
    base = base - Pos(x, 0, 0) * Cylinder(mount_hole_diameter / 2, arm_thickness * 2)

part = base
part.name = "ribbed_arm"
export_step(part, "output.step")
